joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until((#Up_Light).light_currentBrightness > 0)
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Up_Light).light_currentBrightness > 0)
(#Up_Light).light_movetobrightness(100, 0)
triggered = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 상단부에 있는 조명이 켜질 때마다, 하단부에 있는 조명도 켜줘.
command_eng: Whenever a light in the upper part is turned on, turn on a light in the lower part as well.
